verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice-agent platform, so turn-taking and end-of-turn detection is a fair axis to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions model-based end-of-turn detection, VAD settings, silence thresholds, or interruption handling. The pathway, testbed, voice and SIP docs cover other features and do not address this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
